local_model_evaluation.current_task: Brand plugin narrowed to one remaining difference, with several causes ruled out by evidence. Verified: our module materialises, apply runs, both slots.inject callbacks fire (materialised/applied/slotFired all true); our apply is byte-for-byte the same shape as brand-official (nested slots.inject + generator yielding register calls, inject=["slots"]); adding immediately:true to our dsh.client changed nothing; and with the official brand enabled the sidebar logo row (hHd-Xa_logoRow) renders 3 SVGs while our text never appears, while with the official row disabled the same row is empty. So the slot renders, but only the official occupant is accepted. Two remaining explanations, both cheap to test: (a) the slot accepts a single occupant and the official registration wins, or (b) our component is never accepted because the React element we build does not belong to the app renderer (react/jsx-runtime resolved differently in our bundle), which would fail silently. Also removed the earlier guessed disable row for dsh-client-ui-brand-official from both the code path and the profile patch, since disabling a plugin by a guessed id is exactly the kind of unverified guess this project forbids; the official brand is back on.
